## {.smaller}
validity  
  : the main extent to which a concept, conclusion, or measurement is well-founded and likely corresponds accurately to the real world. 

reliability  
  : the overall consistency of a measure. A measure is said to have a high reliability if it produces similar results under consistent conditions  

bias  
  : a systematic tendency in which the methods used to gather data and estimate a sample statistic present an inaccurate, skewed or distorted depiction of reality.
